--- title: "Full Example: Café Norte — Analysis and Construction of Data Marts (Kimball)" format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 3 number-sections: true execute: echo: true warning: false message: false jupyter: python3 --- ## Purpose and Assumptions Following the **Kimball methodology**, this end-to-end example documents the construction of conformed dimensions and a **line-item granularity** fact table to evaluate the impact of a mobile app launch (January 2023) and loyalty program. Serving as the practical capstone of this section, it applies granularity, additivity, star schemas, controlled redundancy, and conformed dimensions in a complete case study. **Intervention Cutoff:** `2023-01-01`. Defined as: - **Pre-intervention period**: Order dates strictly before `2023-01-01`. - **Post-intervention period**: Order dates on or after `2023-01-01`. It is assumed the analyst possesses source CSV datasets exported from operational point-of-sale (POS) systems, mobile application backends, and master catalogs. --- ## 1. Expected CSV File Structure Place raw CSV files inside a `data/` directory located at the same level as this `.qmd` document. ### 1.1 Master Catalogs (Dimensions) - `data/clientes.csv` Minimum fields: `cliente_id`, `fecha_alta`, `tipo_cliente`, `nivel_lealtad`. - `data/productos.csv` Minimum fields: `sku`, `nombre`, `categoria`, `subcategoria`, `tamano`, `activo`. - `data/sucursales.csv` Minimum fields: `sucursal_id`, `nombre`, `zona`, `formato`. - (Optional) `data/promociones.csv` Minimum fields: `promo_codigo`, `campania`, `descripcion`. ### 1.2 Transactions (Facts) It is recommended to maintain order headers and order line items as separate files. - `data/pedidos_pos.csv` and `data/pedidos_app.csv` Minimum fields: `order_id`, `fecha`, `cliente_id`, `sucursal_id`, `canal` (`POS` or `APP`). - `data/lineas_pos.csv` and `data/lineas_app.csv` Minimum fields: `order_id`, `line_num`, `sku`, `cantidad`, `precio_unitario`, `promo_codigo`, `metodo_pago`, `cancelado_flag`. > Note: If discount amounts are itemized at source, include `descuento_importe`. Otherwise, derive it during ETL transformation. --- ## 2. Data Loading and Schema Validation In a reproducible pipeline, **the initial stage** ingests raw data and applies strict validation checks: data types, non-null keys, controlled domain constraints, and numeric ranges. ::: {#700897ea .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd import numpy as np from pathlib import Path DATA_DIR = Path("../../data") def read_csv(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame: if not path.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found: {path.resolve()}") return pd.read_csv(path) clientes = read_csv(DATA_DIR / "clientes.csv") productos = read_csv(DATA_DIR / "productos.csv") sucursales = read_csv(DATA_DIR / "sucursales.csv") ped_pos = read_csv(DATA_DIR / "pedidos_pos.csv") ped_app = read_csv(DATA_DIR / "pedidos_app.csv") lin_pos = read_csv(DATA_DIR / "lineas_pos.csv") lin_app = read_csv(DATA_DIR / "lineas_app.csv") # Promotions catalog is optional prom_path = DATA_DIR / "promociones.csv" promociones = read_csv(prom_path) if prom_path.exists() else None # Quick inspection clientes.head(), productos.head(), sucursales.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ( cliente_id fecha_alta tipo_cliente nivel_lealtad 0 C000001 2021-09-10 lealtad Plata 1 C000002 2022-02-15 sin_lealtad NaN 2 C000003 2022-06-01 lealtad Bronce 3 C000004 2022-11-20 sin_lealtad NaN 4 C000005 2023-01-05 lealtad Oro, sku nombre categoria subcategoria tamano activo 0 SKU0001 Americano Bebidas Calientes Americano M 1 1 SKU0002 Latte Bebidas Calientes Latte G 1 2 SKU0003 Capuccino Bebidas Calientes Capuccino M 1 3 SKU0004 Cold Brew Bebidas Frías Cold Brew M 1 4 SKU0005 Frappé Vainilla Bebidas Frías Frappé G 1, sucursal_id nombre zona formato 0 S001 Centro 1 Centro Tienda 1 S002 Norte 1 Norte Tienda 2 S003 Sur 1 Sur Tienda 3 S004 Oriente 1 Oriente Kiosco 4 S005 Poniente 1 Poniente Kiosco) ``` ::: ::: ### 2.1 Minimum Quality Checks Below are baseline validation rules. In a production DW, these assertions feed automated data monitoring frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations). ::: {#8ad5c982 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} def assert_columns(df: pd.DataFrame, required: list[str], name: str): missing = [c for c in required if c not in df.columns] if missing: raise ValueError(f"[{name}] Missing required columns: {missing}") # Minimal schema assertions assert_columns(clientes, ["cliente_id", "fecha_alta"], "clientes") assert_columns(productos, ["sku", "nombre", "categoria"], "productos") assert_columns(sucursales,["sucursal_id", "nombre", "zona"], "sucursales") assert_columns(ped_pos, ["order_id","fecha","cliente_id","sucursal_id","canal"], "pedidos_pos") assert_columns(ped_app, ["order_id","fecha","cliente_id","sucursal_id","canal"], "pedidos_app") assert_columns(lin_pos, ["order_id","line_num","sku","cantidad","precio_unitario"], "lineas_pos") assert_columns(lin_app, ["order_id","line_num","sku","cantidad","precio_unitario"], "lineas_app") # Date type casting and validation for df, col, name in [ (clientes, "fecha_alta", "clientes"), (ped_pos, "fecha", "pedidos_pos"), (ped_app, "fecha", "pedidos_app"), ]: df[col] = pd.to_datetime(df[col], errors="coerce") if df[col].isna().any(): bad = df[df[col].isna()].head(5) raise ValueError(f"[{name}] Invalid dates in '{col}'. Examples:\n{bad}") # Non-null operational key enforcement def assert_not_null(df: pd.DataFrame, cols: list[str], name: str): for c in cols: if df[c].isna().any(): raise ValueError(f"[{name}] Null values found in key column: {c}") assert_not_null(ped_pos, ["order_id","cliente_id","sucursal_id"], "pedidos_pos") assert_not_null(ped_app, ["order_id","cliente_id","sucursal_id"], "pedidos_app") assert_not_null(lin_pos, ["order_id","sku"], "lineas_pos") assert_not_null(lin_app, ["order_id","sku"], "lineas_app") # Controlled domain validation valid_channels = {"POS","APP"} if not set(ped_pos["canal"].unique()).issubset(valid_channels): raise ValueError(f"[pedidos_pos] Channel out of domain: {set(ped_pos['canal'].unique()) - valid_channels}") if not set(ped_app["canal"].unique()).issubset(valid_channels): raise ValueError(f"[pedidos_app] Channel out of domain: {set(ped_app['canal'].unique()) - valid_channels}") # Numeric range assertions for df, name in [(lin_pos,"lineas_pos"), (lin_app,"lineas_app")]: if (df["cantidad"] <= 0).any(): raise ValueError(f"[{name}] Quantities <= 0 detected") if (df["precio_unitario"] < 0).any(): raise ValueError(f"[{name}] Negative unit prices detected") print("Minimum quality checks: OK") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Minimum quality checks: OK ``` ::: ::: --- ## 3. Standardization and Source Integration (Integrated Staging) In Kimball architecture, logical integration is achieved through **conformed dimensions** and a **bus matrix**. POS and App datasets are integrated before constructing dimensional models. ### 3.1 Header and Line Item Integration ::: {#6215467b .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Combine headers and line items pedidos = pd.concat([ped_pos, ped_app], ignore_index=True) lineas = pd.concat([lin_pos, lin_app], ignore_index=True) # Standardize text values pedidos["canal"] = pedidos["canal"].str.upper() # --- GLOBAL UNIQUE KEY --- # If order_id overlaps between POS and APP, create compound key order_uid pedidos["order_uid"] = pedidos["canal"].astype(str) + "-" + pedidos["order_id"].astype(str) lin_pos_ = lin_pos.copy() lin_pos_["canal"] = "POS" lin_app_ = lin_app.copy() lin_app_["canal"] = "APP" lineas = pd.concat([lin_pos_, lin_app_], ignore_index=True) lineas["canal"] = lineas["canal"].str.upper() lineas["order_uid"] = lineas["canal"].astype(str) + "-" + lineas["order_id"].astype(str) # Default values for flags lineas["promo_codigo"] = lineas.get("promo_codigo", pd.Series(["NA"]*len(lineas))).fillna("NA") lineas["cancelado_flag"] = lineas.get("cancelado_flag", 0) lineas["cancelado_flag"] = lineas["cancelado_flag"].fillna(0).astype(int) # Deduplicate headers: keep most recent record if pedidos["order_uid"].duplicated().any(): n_dup = pedidos["order_uid"].duplicated().sum() print(f"Warning: {n_dup} duplicate order headers; retaining latest by 'fecha'.") pedidos = pedidos.sort_values("fecha").drop_duplicates(subset=["order_uid"], keep="last") # Merge headers and line items at line granularity stg = lineas.merge(pedidos.drop(columns=["order_id", "canal"]), on=["order_uid"], how="left", validate="m:1") # Referential integrity check if stg["fecha"].isna().any(): bad = stg[stg["fecha"].isna()][["order_id","order_uid","line_num","canal"]].head(10) raise ValueError(f"Line items exist without an associated order header. Examples:\n{bad}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Warning: 13 duplicate order headers; retaining latest by 'fecha'. ``` ::: ::: ### 3.2 Derivation of Transactional Metrics Calculated monetary values should be stored directly in fact tables to prevent dependency on changing master prices over time. ::: {#8f6f749f .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Gross calculation stg["importe_bruto"] = (stg["cantidad"] * stg["precio_unitario"]).astype(float) # Discount amounts if "descuento_importe" not in stg.columns: stg["descuento_importe"] = 0.0 else: stg["descuento_importe"] = stg["descuento_importe"].fillna(0.0).astype(float) stg["importe_neto"] = stg["importe_bruto"] - stg["descuento_importe"] # Cancellation logic: force net amount to zero for cancelled items stg.loc[stg["cancelado_flag"].eq(1), "importe_neto"] = 0.0 # Coupon flag stg["cupon_aplicado_flag"] = (stg["promo_codigo"].fillna("NA") != "NA").astype(int) stg[["order_id","line_num","cantidad","precio_unitario","importe_bruto","descuento_importe","importe_neto", "cancelado_flag","promo_codigo","cupon_aplicado_flag"]].head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ```{=html}

Building Conformed Dimensions In a star schema, every dimension table requires: - An integer **surrogate key** (`*_key`), - A **natural key** from operational systems (`cliente_id`, `sku`, etc.), - Descriptive attributes. This example implements SCD Type 1 (overwriting changes). In production environments, `dim_cliente` and `dim_producto` typically implement SCD Type 2. ### 4.1 `dim_tiempo` (Time Dimension) ::: {#f6041457 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} min_date = stg["fecha"].min().normalize() max_date = stg["fecha"].max().normalize() dim_tiempo = pd.DataFrame({"fecha": pd.date_range(min_date, max_date, freq="D")}) dim_tiempo["anio"] = dim_tiempo["fecha"].dt.year dim_tiempo["mes"] = dim_tiempo["fecha"].dt.month dim_tiempo["trimestre"] = dim_tiempo["fecha"].dt.quarter dim_tiempo["semana_iso"] = dim_tiempo["fecha"].dt.isocalendar().week.astype(int) dim_tiempo["dia_semana"] = dim_tiempo["fecha"].dt.dayofweek + 1 dim_tiempo["es_fin_semana"] = dim_tiempo["dia_semana"].isin([6,7]).astype(int) dim_tiempo.insert(0, "tiempo_key", np.arange(1, len(dim_tiempo)+1, dtype=int)) dim_tiempo.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ### 4.2 Helper Function for Dimensions (Type 1) ::: {#e1f49254 .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} def build_dim_type1(df: pd.DataFrame, natural_key: str, attrs: list[str], sk_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame: out = df[[natural_key] + attrs].drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True) out.insert(0, sk_name, np.arange(1, len(out)+1, dtype=int)) return out # Channel dimension dim_canal = pd.DataFrame({"canal": ["POS","APP"]}) dim_canal.insert(0, "canal_key", [1,2]) # Payment method dimension if "metodo_pago" not in stg.columns: stg["metodo_pago"] = "NA" dim_metodo_pago = pd.DataFrame({"metodo_pago": sorted(stg["metodo_pago"].fillna("NA").unique())}) dim_metodo_pago.insert(0, "metodo_pago_key", np.arange(1, len(dim_metodo_pago)+1, dtype=int)) # Promotion dimension if promociones is None: dim_promocion = pd.DataFrame({"promo_codigo": sorted(stg["promo_codigo"].fillna("NA").unique())}) else: dim_promocion = promociones.copy() if "promo_codigo" not in dim_promocion.columns: raise ValueError("promociones.csv must contain 'promo_codigo'") if "NA" not in set(dim_promocion["promo_codigo"].astype(str).unique()): dim_promocion = pd.concat([pd.DataFrame({"promo_codigo":["NA"]}), dim_promocion], ignore_index=True) dim_promocion["promo_codigo"] = dim_promocion["promo_codigo"].astype(str).fillna("NA") dim_promocion = dim_promocion.drop_duplicates(subset=["promo_codigo"]).reset_index(drop=True) dim_promocion.insert(0, "promocion_key", np.arange(1, len(dim_promocion)+1, dtype=int)) dim_promocion.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=6} ```{=html}

Building the Fact Table (`fact_linea_pedido`) The fact table is modeled at **order line-item granularity**, including: - Foreign surrogate keys linking to conformed dimensions. - Additive measures (`cantidad`, `importe_*`) and flags (`cancelado_flag`, `cupon_aplicado_flag`). - Degenerate key `order_id` for order-level traceability. ::: {#e884405c .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} fact = (stg .merge(dim_tiempo[["tiempo_key","fecha"]], on="fecha", how="left") .merge(dim_cliente[["cliente_key","cliente_id"]], on="cliente_id", how="left") .merge(dim_sucursal[["sucursal_key","sucursal_id"]], on="sucursal_id", how="left") .merge(dim_producto[["producto_key","sku"]], on="sku", how="left") .merge(dim_canal[["canal_key","canal"]], on="canal", how="left") .merge(dim_metodo_pago[["metodo_pago_key","metodo_pago"]], on="metodo_pago", how="left") .merge(dim_promocion[["promocion_key","promo_codigo"]], on="promo_codigo", how="left")) # Dimensional integrity assertion for col in ["tiempo_key","cliente_key","sucursal_key","producto_key","canal_key","metodo_pago_key","promocion_key"]: if fact[col].isna().any(): bad = fact[fact[col].isna()][["order_id","line_num"]].head(10) raise ValueError(f"Rows found without dimension mapping for '{col}'. Examples:\n{bad}") fact_linea_pedido = fact[[ "order_id","line_num", "tiempo_key","cliente_key","sucursal_key","producto_key", "canal_key","metodo_pago_key","promocion_key", "cantidad","precio_unitario","importe_bruto","descuento_importe","importe_neto", "cancelado_flag","cupon_aplicado_flag" ]].copy() fact_linea_pedido.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=8} ```{=html}

::: {#e279ec12 .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} APP_LAUNCH = pd.Timestamp("2023-01-01") fact_time = fact_linea_pedido.merge( dim_tiempo[["tiempo_key","fecha","anio","mes"]], on="tiempo_key", how="left" ) fact_time["yyyymm"] = fact_time["fecha"].dt.to_period("M").astype(str) mask_2023 = fact_time["fecha"] >= APP_LAUNCH q1 = (fact_time.loc[mask_2023] .groupby("yyyymm") .agg(pedidos=("order_id","nunique"), lineas=("order_id","size"), ingreso_neto=("importe_neto","sum")) .reset_index() .sort_values("yyyymm")) fact_time_canal = fact_time.merge(dim_canal, on="canal_key", how="left") q1_canal = (fact_time_canal.loc[mask_2023] .groupby(["yyyymm","canal"]) .agg(pedidos=("order_id","nunique"), ingreso_neto=("importe_neto","sum")) .reset_index() .sort_values(["yyyymm","canal"])) q1.head(), q1_canal.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=9} ``` ( yyyymm pedidos lineas ingreso_neto 0 2023-02 1 3 389.25 1 2023-03 1 3 Technical Discussion: Design Decisions and Extensions 1. **Conformed Dimensions**: `dim_tiempo`, `dim_cliente`, `dim_producto`, `dim_sucursal`, and `dim_canal` enable querying POS and App sales under a single bus matrix architecture. 2. **Granularity**: Modeling at line-item level preserves product mix analysis and promotion evaluation. 3. **SCD Type 2 Extension**: To preserve historical changes in `categoria` or `nivel_lealtad`, extend dimension tables with `valid_from`, `valid_to`, and `is_current` flags. 4. **Late-Arriving Dimensions**: For transactions arriving prior to customer creation in master catalogs, assign an **Unknown Member** key (`*_key = 0`) and reconcile during subsequent batch cycles. 5. **Pre/Post Hypothesis Testing**: Formally evaluate intervention impacts using non-parametric or bootstrap hypothesis tests on monthly metrics. --- ## 9. Reproducibility and Version Control Best practices for analytical pipelines: - Lock dependency versions (`pandas==2.x`, `numpy==2.x`). - Keep raw input datasets outside version control repositories. - Track pipeline scripts and `.qmd` files in Git. - Document data dictionaries for all facts and dimensions.
